sanctionedPlanReview.geometryDecision: The closed outlines are local plan-space geometry only. No WGS84 grid, coordinate schedule, benchmark, or multiple survey control points were provided for a repeatable transformation into a PostGIS footprint.
sanctionedPlanReview.nextRequirement: Provide survey control/GNSS points, a georeferenced sanctioned plan, or a documented match to an independently licensed source footprint before creating a map polygon or rendering a 14.90 m extrusion.
